description: Stop the agent in one run before it finishes. Its work in progress is lost, and the run's status becomes stopped a few seconds later. Needs an org admin and the sandboxes:stop scope. This stops one agent run, not the mission: to stop the whole mission, use POST /v1/missions/{issueId}/stop.

sandboxId.description: Agent run id: the run's sandbox id, from list_agent_runs

name: stop_agent_run
title: Stop an agent run
